events.name: Beer Pong
events.description: Ten standard red Solo cups in a triangle. Throw or bounce balls into cups.
rules: Ten standard red Solo cups in a triangle. Throw or bounce balls into cups.
Retrieve your own balls. One cup rearrangement allowed. Fastest completion wins.

events.name: Bottle Flip Frenzy
events.description: 60 seconds, using the same bottle for everyone.
rules: 60 seconds, using the same bottle for everyone.
Count successful bottle flips. Most successful flips within 60 seconds wins.

events.name: Higher or Lower
events.description: Freshly shuffled 52-card deck for each competitor; external 60-second timer.
rules: Freshly shuffled 52-card deck for each competitor; external 60-second timer.
Reveal a reference card. Predict higher or lower. Correct guesses add to the current streak.
Wrong or equal rank resets the streak to zero; the revealed card becomes the next reference. Continue immediately.
Stop at 60 seconds or deck exhaustion. No stopping or banking. Only the longest consecutive correct streak counts.

events.name: Pigskin Accuracy Toss
events.description: Three throws at a target marker. Only the closest throw counts.
rules: Three attempts to throw a football as close to a target marker. Only the closest throw counts.
Measure every throw's distance in inches. Shortest distance wins.

events.name: 40M Dash
events.description: Run the same marked sprint course; it doesn't need to be exactly 40 meters
rules: Run the same marked sprint course;
Use an external stopwatch. Fastest time wins.

events.name: Choose Your Character
events.description: Pick a CPU fighter. Last character standing wins.
rules: Set up one seven-character CPU-only free-for-all. Each competitor chooses a character to fight for them.
No human controls during the fight. This event is entirely luck.
Record the full elimination order: the last character standing finishes 1st; the first eliminated finishes 7th.
Enter a finishing place from 1 to 7 for each competitor. Shared finishing places use the normal tournament tie rules.

events.name: Mario Kart
events.description: Time trial on the same course; own kart and character allowed. Resolve tied seeds explicitly.
rules: Time trial on the same course (one lap); choose own kart and character allowed. Resolve tied seeds explicitly.
Seed 1 gets a bye. Wild Card: 2 vs 7, 3 vs 6, 4 vs 5.
Higher seed chooses the course. Own kart and character; no items.
Reseed semifinals: seed 1 faces the highest numerical remaining seed.
Championship and third-place races decide places 1–4. Wild Card losers tie for 5th and each receive 1 base point.

events.name: Relay Race
events.description: Individual five-station obstacle course. Unlimited attempts; one continuous external stopwatch, nearest 0.01 second.
rules: Individual five-station obstacle course. Unlimited attempts; one continuous external stopwatch, nearest 0.01 second.
1 · Cup Roller — roll a ping pong ball across a table into a cup.
2 · Dice Jackpot — roll two dice until their sum is 10 or higher.
3 · Suit Hunt — reveal the first card of a preshuffled face-down deck. Find and stack all 13 cards of that suit, including that card. Flip, spread and rearrange freely.
4 · Flip Cup Triple — three cups start upside down at the table edge. Flip each until upright.
5 · Paper Plane Landing — build a plane while the clock runs, then throw until any part touches the target.

events.name: Single Week Fantasy Score
events.description: Sunday, November 8, 2026 only, including Sunday Night Football. Thursday and Monday performances are excluded.
rules: Sunday, November 8, 2026 only, including Sunday Night Football. Thursday and Monday performances are excluded.
Use your actual ESPN league scoring settings and only eligible starters. The administrator verifies Sunday-only totals.

The administrator enters all seven scores manually or uploads a screenshot matching all seven configured team names. Reviewed provisional fantasy points contribute to tournament totals. Finalization requires administrator confirmation.
